test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 3).
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully.

When the last Tsar of Russia (were arrested by revolutionaries), he and his family were hiding at a palace near St. Petersburg; now that palace is open to tourists.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** error exists** in the bracketed segment. In the context of the sentence, the verb** "were"** is** incorrect **because the subject "the last Tsar of Russia" is singular. English grammar rules dictate that singular subjects require singular verbs.
 
• The **correct verb to use** is **"was**". Every singular noun is paired with a singular verb in the past tense when the action is complete.
 
• The past participle form of the verb **"arrest"** is **"arrested"**. The **correct preposition** to use after "arrested" is "**by**", which indicates who performed the action.

Therefore, the **correct phrase** is: *"was arrested by revolutionaries"*, which means the last Tsar of Russia was captured by the revolutionaries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, 3, and 4 propose forms of "arrest" that do not agree with the tense and number of the subject.
 
• The plural verb "were" (in Options 1 and 3) does not match with the singular subject "the last Tsar of Russia". 
 
• Also, the present tense "is" (in options 1 and 4) does not fit into the context of the sentence which is in the past tense.
